holder-quote: Zel moved before the undead could speak. He sprinted right, into Venitra and Ijvani and slashed.
effect-quote: Ijvani cried out as Zel raked a claw across her arms and ribs, slicing across her black bones.

holder-quote: He charged at her. Mars saw his sword blur. She jerked back. The [Lightning Slash] sent crackling electricity dancing across her chest. She brought her sword up. Fultoolm saw it coming. He didn’t close his eyes.
